items.name_en: 'Wisdom of Thai Happiness' set menu (excluding beverages)

Amuse-bouche, nine tastes: sour (papaya and tomato with som tum spheres), salty (sun-dried beef), sweet (crispy rice noodles in golden cups with wild honeycomb), spicy (Northern Thai pork sausage), rich (foie gras terrine with berry sauce), bitter (Parmesan sphere, bitter-melon jelly, Spanish sweet shrimp), astringent (Northern Thai pounded jackfruit salad), fizzy (three-breed free-range chicken with makhwaen pepper), umami (laab croquettes with nine expressions of fermentation)
Course 2, Wisdom of Thai Cuisine: shrimp paste chilli dip with Chiang Rai Japanese rice, mackerel roe, torched otoro and caviar
Course 3, Pearl of the Andaman: lobster with galangal cream, Champagne, lemongrass, asparagus and coriander oil
Course 4, Gulf of Thailand: steamed grouper with flat rice noodles and crispy flaked fish in dry red curry
Course 5, Wisdom of Wellness: grilled Japanese A4 wagyu marinated with tea-seed oil, cassia leaf coconut cream curry
Sorbet: Thai tea with a selection of nine Thai fruits

Main course: Tom Yum Kung (Thailand's UNESCO dish) with king river prawn; King of Herbs Phuket blue crab curry with sea purslane; Lanna black pork nam prik ong; Amazing Thai Rice (nine heritage rice varieties herb-baked with black garlic) or first-light Thai hom mali rice
Dessert, A Celebration of Himmapan: toasted pancake wrap with candied coconut, mango sticky rice, mushroom meringue, fresh coconut and truffle-infused coconut ice cream
Petit fours: toddy palm soufflé, rice liqueur Thai chocolate, monthong durian macaron, bael fruit canelé
